mails.subject: Guest post opportunity for your coworking blog
mails.body:
Hello,

I am writing on behalf of Rankbridge Media, a content placement agency working with companies in the workspace and remote work sector.
I have been reading your community pages and I think your domain would be a good fit for a sponsored article we are preparing for one of our clients, a provider of ergonomic desk accessories.
Here is what we propose:
- One article of about 900 words, written by our team and adapted to your tone
- Two contextual links to our client's site (https://deskwell-supply.example/shop)
- Publication on your blog within 7 days of your approval
- A one-time fee of 150 EUR paid to you by bank transfer

We can also discuss a recurring arrangement if you have several pages that receive regular traffic. Many of our partners publish one article per month and see a steady additional income.
If this is of interest, simply reply with the URL of the page you would like to use and I will send over the draft and our terms.
If you are not the right person to speak to, could you forward this to whoever manages your website?

Kind regards,
Marcus Veldt
Partnerships, Rankbridge Media
https://rankbridge-media.example
mails.justification: Cold offer of paid guest posts and backlinks from an agency the space has never dealt with.

mails.subject: Succession en déshérence - bénéficiaire potentiel
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Je suis Maître Bernard Caillaux, notaire. Un client de notre étude est décédé sans héritier connu, laissant un compte d'un montant de 4 200 000 EUR.
Après recherches, votre établissement porte le même nom que celui du défunt, ce qui nous permet de vous proposer d'être désigné bénéficiaire.
La procédure est entièrement confidentielle. Vous recevriez 40 % de la somme, le reste couvrant les frais et les parts de l'étude.
Pour avancer, merci de me retourner une copie de votre pièce d'identité et vos coordonnées bancaires par retour de courrier.
Le dossier doit être clos avant la fin du mois.

Respectueusement,
Maître Bernard Caillaux
mails.justification: Classic inheritance scam from an unknown sender asking for identity and bank details.

mails.subject: Re: Invitation til vores digitale salgskonference
mails.body:
Hej igen,

Jeg følger op på min tidligere mail: "Vi vil gerne invitere jer til en gratis konference om moderne B2B-salg."
Vi afholder webinaret SalesShift 2026 torsdag den 15. oktober kl. 10.00, hvor fem talere gennemgår nye værktøjer til lead-generering og opfølgning.
Deltagelse er gratis, og alle tilmeldte får vores e-bog om kundeemner.
Du kan tilmelde dig her: https://skyfunnel-events.example/salgsshift
Hvis I ikke ønsker flere invitationer, kan I afmelde jer nederst på siden.

Venlig hilsen
Lise Brandt
Skyfunnel Events
mails.justification: Mass marketing invitation to a webinar from a company the space never contacted, styled as a reply to a thread that never existed.

mails.subject: Great meeting you at the autumn meetup - partnership idea
mails.body:
Hi,

It was great to be at your recent community evening and to see how well the space brings people together. We did not get a chance to talk properly, but I wanted to follow up.
I run Northquay Collective, a network of founders and creative professionals across the Nordics. We believe the two communities could create a lot of value together.
Some ideas we could explore:
- Joint events shared between our members and yours
- Cross-promotion on our newsletters and social channels
- An exclusive membership tier for our network at your space
- A joint sponsorship package starting at 12 000 DKK per quarter

We have already spoken with several other spaces in the region and the interest has been very strong.
I would love to set up a short call to align on the vision and see how we can work together. Just let me know when suits you.
If you could also send over your current membership pricing and attendance figures, that would help us shape the offer.

Looking forward to building something together,
Oliver Nance
Founder, Northquay Collective
mails.justification: Vague partnership proposal referring to an event with no specifics, from a sender the space has no relationship with, ending in a paid sponsorship pitch.

mails.subject: Votre site et vos réseaux : une idée rapide
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je me permets de vous ecrire depuis mon telephone car je viens de voir votre espace sur internet et j'ai eu envie de vous contacter tout de suite.
Je suis Julien, de l'agence Pixelorbit. Nous aidons les lieux comme le votre a obtenir plus de reservations grace a des outils de prospection automatisés.
Concrètement, nous pouvons : refaire votre site en deux semaines, mettre en place une séquence d'emails pour vos prospects, et gerer vos publications sur les reseaux.
Nos clients voient en moyenne 30 % de contacts en plus en trois mois, et nous travaillons sans engagement.
Je serais ravi de vous presenter une demo gratuite de 15 minutes cette semaine ou la prochaine.
Dites moi simplement quel creneau vous arrange, ou appelez moi directement.
Nous avons aussi une equipe en offshore qui peut prendre en charge vos taches repetitives a tarif reduit.
Vous pouvez voir quelques exemples ici : https://pixelorbit-agence.example/refs

Bien cordialement,
Julien Marchal
Pixelorbit - agence digitale
06 00 00 00 00
Envoyé de mon iPhone

mails.subject: Eksklusiv mulighed - 300 % afkast
mails.body:
Hej,

Jeg hedder Frederik og arbejder med en lukket investeringsgruppe inden for kryptovaluta.
Vores medlemmer har i år opnået op til 300 % afkast på tre måneder, og vi har netop åbnet nogle få nye pladser.
Minimumsindbetalingen er 2 500 EUR, og du kan komme i gang i dag.
Skriv blot tilbage, så sender jeg dig et link til din personlige konto.
Pladserne bliver fordelt efter først til mølle, så vent ikke for længe.

Med venlig hilsen
Frederik Lund
mails.justification: Crypto investment scam promising extreme returns, sent late at night by an unknown sender.
